method.judgedBy: an agent that wrote none of the algorithms
method.budget: Budget(max_iterations=2_000_000, max_nodes=20_000_000, seed=0) — the harness CLI default, identical for every router
method.runsPerCell: 2, in one process (fresh router instance, then the same instance again); a separate cross-process spot check ran 4 routers on harness-puck under PYTHONHASHSEED=random
method.harness: routerlib.scoring.score — the same scorer the families were graded on
method.pipelineRealBoard: the router's copper dropped into the real examples/ or rebuilt composition-cell circuit.json via routerlib.adapters.apply_solution, then @tscircuit/checks (per-check, failures isolated) and kicad-cli pcb drc with this fab's rules written into the project file. Available for 12 of 16 instances: the 3 synthetic plane variants have no real board, and terminal-keyboard's board on disk has drifted 104 pads from the committed instance. pcb_copper_pour is stripped because the instance was extracted with strip_planes=True. An empty-solution control runs on every board and is subtracted.
method.pipelineSynthesized: the same two engines over circuit_json_for_scoring, with every SMD pad emitted as rotated_rect — exactly the geometry routerlib.geometry.pad_capsule models. Measures check-logic disagreement on identical geometry, not real-world defect count: for polygon/circle/pill pads the rectangle is larger than the pad, so these counts run high.
method.padModelBlindSpot: every (pad, trace segment) pair measured twice — against routerlib's inscribed stadium and against the true rotated rectangle — counting the pairs where the two disagree across the 0.09mm gate. 948 of 1037 sampled cases are plain rect pads, where the rectangle is the pad.
